verdict.rationale: Lovable's enterprise docs mention 'regional code hosting' as one of several enterprise features, indicating some data residency control exists for enterprise customers, but there's no detail on which regions, how it's configured, or whether it applies to database/user data (vs just code) or non-enterprise plans. missing for 10: region selection details, database/data storage residency (not just code hosting), self-serve availability for non-enterprise users, independent confirmation.
